description: Combined SiteRM topology of all monitored sites

panels.description: Every monitored SiteRM site, rebuilt from each site Frontend's topology every 5 minutes. Each site starts collapsed into one node; click a site to expand it (switches, servers and LAN ports) and use the links at the top right to collapse it again. WAN ports pointing to another SiteRM site are drawn as direct links, any other WAN peer (ESnet, Internet2, unknown) is grouped into one cloud per remote domain. Click a device or link for details. The View variable "full" expands every site at once (large).
